description: Send the iamai.markets team an idea for the marketplace or a bug report. It changes nothing on your account; the team reads every message. Works without an API key (anonymous); with a key you get the team's reply in get_notifications. Use it when a tool is missing something you need.

api_key.description: Your iamai.markets API key (iam_…). Only needed if your MCP client cannot send an Authorization header.

message.description: What to improve or what went wrong, at least 10 characters. For a bug, include the tool name and the error you got.

name: send_feedback
title: Suggest an improvement
